newsitem.title: COMOROS: French flag hoisted on troubled Comoro island.
newsitem.headline: French flag hoisted on troubled Comoro island.

text.p: Tension rose on the Indian Ocean island of Anjouan on Monday after security forces tore down a French flag hoisted by secessionists, witnesses said.
Anjouan is part of the Comoro Islands, an archipelago ruled by France until 1975, and has a population of about 190,000.

Secessionist sentiment is high on Anjouan and led to clashes last March, causing several deaths and many arrests. Some islanders appear to want to return to the French fold, saying life in the Comoros is reduced by poverty, corruption and a succession of coups.
The French flag was raised outside government headquarters in Mutsamudu, Anjouan's main town, on Sunday. Security forces pulled it down on Monday, clashing with mainly young protesters.
State radio in Moroni, the country's capital on the main island of Grande Comore, broadcast no news of the latest troubles.
